primary: final_norm at task-free ONE_END; correct-minus-original-wrong contrast, length-centered and common answer strata, with matched initialization contrasts
secondary: final_norm at task-specific equals position; all prefix layers; independent random initialization; confidence residualization
answer_strata: common key (length, left answer on identity, right answers on identity/complement/inverse); retain strata >=3; subtract each stratum mean separately in every branch using the same retained anchors
input_control: Report same-seed and independent random networks, positional permutation-matrix and normalized numeric-input CKA, and within-answer-stratum row permutations. These controls do not remove every possible input confounder and are not the PSD dCKA algorithm.
confidence_control: Fit ridge on FIT only, fixed alpha; nuisance is length onehot plus max numeric probability, entropy, probability of true answer and top-two logit margin. Evaluate on TEST; supplemental and does not prove causal mediation.
inference_scope: Fresh permutations conditional on the original eight relations, three source seeds and one existing source data world. Relation-seed cells share data/tasks and are not independent trials. No result-dependent task/model/transform/stratum selection. Higher hidden CKA than output CKA alone is not independent-mechanism evidence.
